open_doubts.evidence: deeper entry (index 1); reason recorded: The asserted value is block_idx, which is not a parameter of the official entry flex_prefill_attention: the entry builds it internally with get_active_blocks, which always returns exactly [batch_size, q.shape[2]] lists (transform_veritcal_slash_idx iterates range(q.shape[2])) and then passes it to the target unchanged. So len(block_idx)==batch_size and len(block_idx[0])==num_q_heads is an internal invariant and the target assertion cannot fire through flex_prefill_attention. Making the head counts non-divisible does not help: get_active_blocks fails earlier, before the target, on the q/k einsum/view shapes. The drivers still call the real target function with a real caller-supplied block_idx list; only the entry depth moves from call_chain[0] to call_chain[1] so the asserted block_idx width can be varied. This is why D14 stays residual and cannot be eliminated without mocking code before the target.
